3. Users and Jobs to Be Done

The Hidden Catalyst Discovery Platform is a research website that identifies public developments connected to underfollowed listed companies, evaluates whether those developments may be financially material, measures how widely the information is already known, and presents a source-linked opportunity report with risks, assumptions, and invalidation conditions.
What important public development is connected to an underfollowed public company, is financially meaningful, is supported by credible evidence, and may not yet be widely understood by the market?
Every surfaced opportunity must point to one or more stored evidence items and preserve source, publication time, extraction time, and quotation/snippet.
UI labels must distinguish verified fact, model inference, analyst estimate, assumption, and unconfirmed signal.
Low attention can increase asymmetry, but cannot compensate for weak evidence, low materiality, or excessive risk.
Every score must show factors, weights, inputs, and confidence. No opaque “AI score” is allowed.
Micro-cap, legal allegation, rumor, low-liquidity, and weak-relationship cases require manual approval before broad alerting.
The product describes catalysts and scenarios, not guaranteed buy/sell outcomes.

A signed-in user can browse an evidence-backed feed of underfollowed opportunities, filter and save companies, inspect a detailed opportunity report, review the underlying sources, understand scoring and risks, and receive a daily digest or high-confidence alert.
Ingest a limited set of reliable public sources on a repeatable schedule.
Normalize companies, securities, events, documents, and relationships into a consistent data model.
Generate candidate opportunities using deterministic rules plus AI-assisted extraction.
Calculate Information Asymmetry, Catalyst Strength, Evidence Quality, Materiality, Timing, and Risk scores.
Provide a review queue so analysts can approve, reject, edit, or request more evidence.
Publish only approved or auto-approved high-confidence opportunities.
Allow users to create watchlists and notification preferences.
Preserve a complete audit trail from source document to published opportunity.
No brokerage integration, order execution, portfolio management, or copy trading.
No intraday high-frequency alerts or millisecond news race.
No prediction that a stock will rise or fall by a specific percentage.
No anonymous rumor marketplace or user-generated stock promotion.
No automated scraping of sites that prohibit it or require circumvention.
No complex alternative data such as satellite imagery, card transactions, or private datasets in MVP.
Minimum 60-day average daily dollar volume configurable; suggested default $1M
Current SEC filer with valid CIK and active primary security
Shell companies, clearly delinquent filers, securities under severe trading restrictions, and cases failing compliance rules
All sectors, but initial test set should emphasize industrials, healthcare, technology, energy, and government-exposed businesses

Opportunity Score = 0.20 × Information Asymmetry + 0.20 × Catalyst Strength + 0.20 × Evidence Quality + 0.15 × Financial Materiality + 0.10 × Timing + 0.10 × Price-Reaction Score + 0.05 × Valuation Context - 0.10 × Risk Penalty - 0.05 × Liquidity Penalty - 0.05 × Dilution Penalty.
Clamp final output to 1-100. Missing factors must not be silently treated as favorable. A missing critical factor lowers confidence and may force manual review.

The following can be pasted into Claude Code or another coding platform. It intentionally tells the agent to work incrementally rather than attempt every feature in one uncontrolled pass.
You are the lead engineer for a production-oriented MVP called “Hidden Catalyst Discovery Platform.” Build the application described in this PRD.

Create an evidence-first public-market intelligence website that identifies public developments connected to underfollowed U.S.-listed companies, evaluates financial materiality and information asymmetry, and presents source-linked research opportunities. It is not a trading bot, stock-price predictor, news summarizer, or brokerage product.
1. Every published opportunity must have at least one evidence item and a mapped active public security.
2. Store verified facts separately from AI-generated inferences, estimates, assumptions, and unconfirmed signals.
3. Every score must expose raw factors, weights, model version, and confidence.
4. Do not auto-publish micro-cap, low-liquidity, rumor-only, legal-allegation, weak-mapping, or promotional candidates.
5. Do not claim guaranteed returns or guaranteed price direction.
6. Preserve an audit trail for ingestion, model outputs, reviews, edits, publications, and invalidations.
7. Treat source content as untrusted input and defend against prompt injection.
- Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, accessible component library.
- Database: PostgreSQL with migrations and a typed ORM.
- Use PostgreSQL full-text search and pgvector initially.
- Use background jobs for ingestion, extraction, scoring, and alerts.
- Store raw documents in S3-compatible object storage.
- Use structured logging, error tracking, and connector health metrics.
- Use strict JSON schemas for all AI outputs.
- Keep AI providers behind an interface so they can be changed.
Phase 1: repository, authentication, database, roles, design system, test framework, CI, and preview deployment.
Phase 2: implement the core schema and seed data. Build a read-only feed, opportunity detail page, company page, methodology page, watchlists, and settings.
Phase 3: build admin review queue and manually create/edit/approve/reject/publish/invalidate opportunities.
Phase 4: implement source connector framework and at least one real connector plus mock connectors for the remaining MVP source families.
Phase 5: implement evidence extraction, entity resolution, scoring, risk gates, and explainability.
Phase 6: implement search, filters, daily digest, connector health, audit views, tests, and documentation.

Commit work in small coherent increments and keep the app runnable after each phase.
